Oneliner

Demonstrate the use and relevance of a satellite relay for UHF communication at high latitudes.
Description

Demonstrate the use and relevance of a satellite relay for UHF communication at high latitudes.
Demonstrate military tactical communications on the UHF band from a polar Low Earth Orbit (LEO). The primary mission objective is to demonstrate the military use and relevance of an Arctic satellite relay for tactical communication radios.
